title: Analog Circuit Design Engineer
jobDescription:
The Role and Impact: At Intel, Analog Circuit Design Engineers are at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of analog and mixed-signal IPs. This critical role involves designing, developing, and optimizing high-speed analog circuits in advanced process nodes, contributing directly to Intel's industry-leading products and technologies. As part of our high-speed IO design team, you will play a pivotal role in creating next-generation memory interface PHYs, driving power, performance, and functionality improvements in cutting-edge circuits. Your expertise will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver high-quality solutions to meet the ever-evolving demands of technology. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Design, develop, and build analog circuits for advanced process nodes, enabling high-performance and robust functionality.
- Perform circuit design, validation, extraction of chip parameters, and simulation of analog behavior models.
- Optimize circuits for power efficiency, performance, area, timing, and yield goals.
- Create test plans to verify designs against block microarchitecture specifications, evaluating test results for design validation.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications, collect feedback, and resolve design issues.
- Conduct layout reviews and ensure optimal placement and routing in collaboration with architecture and layout teams.
- Contribute to post-silicon debug and validation efforts to support high-volume manufacturing.
- Continuously refine design methodologies and processes to improve turnaround time and design quality.
minimumQualification: - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent specialized field, or equivalent experience as required for the role. - 10+ years with Master's degree, or 4+ years with PhD in analog circuit design. - Proficiency with industry-standard tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, PrimeSim, HSPICE, ADE, and Custom Compiler. - Expertise in designing high-speed analog circuits such as TX/RX blocks, PLLs, DLLs, SerDes, and voltage regulators. - Strong fundamentals in CMOS design, circuit simulation, and high-speed analog design concepts. - Familiarity with DRC, LVS, and post-layout extraction tools.
preferredQualification: - Experience in post-silicon debug, electrical validation, and correlating measurements to simulations. - Knowledge of scripting languages such as TCL, Perl, Python, or C for design automation tasks. - Familiarity with modeling and simulation of high-speed interface interconnects and channels. - Strong problem-solving, analytical skills, and ability to work in a fast-paced collaborative team environment. - Demonstrated leadership experience, ability to mentor junior team members, and drive innovation in circuit design. If you are passionate about creating impactful designs, driving technological innovation, and collaborating with a talented team, we invite you to apply and take the next step in your career with Intel. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India)

title: Static Timing Analysis Engineer
jobDescription:
The Role and Impact: As a Physical Design Timing Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Intel's next-generation So Cs by ensuring their optimal performance and efficiency. Your expertise will directly impact the success of Intel's products, enabling innovation across high-performance computing, AI, and beyond. You will work on cutting-edge designs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to tackle complex challenges while delivering high-quality timing models that empower the physical design team to excel. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Intel's mission of shaping the future of technology. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Perform timing analysis and optimization to ensure design functionality and performance at the chip and block levels.
- Generate and verify timing constraints, addressing and resolving timing violations during So C development.
- Conduct timing rollups, develop and implement power-optimized clock networks, and ensure alignment with high-performance, low-power guidelines.
- Define and implement methodologies to deliver quality timing models that enhance the efficiency of the physical design process.
- Set process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) conditions for timing analysis based on product plans and operating conditions.
- Collaborate with architecture, clock design, logic design, and backend teams to achieve clocking balance, power delivery optimization, and efficient partitioning.
- Partner closely with the clocking team to refine methodologies and validate integration flows for chip-level timing solutions.

preferredQualification: - Advanced knowledge of SoC development, clocking design principles, and timing methodologies. - Strong collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work across architecture, logic design, and physical design teams. - Experience in high-performance computing or low-power design environments. - Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on industry advancements. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of technology. Apply today to make your mark. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India)

title: IP RTL Senior Design Engineer
jobDescription:
The Role and Impact: As an IP Logic Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing high-quality intellectual property (IP) for Unified Intel Chassis designs. This position is at the forefront of Intel's innovation, ensuring that our products consistently deliver world-class performance, power efficiency, and reliability. Work closely with architects to define and design complex protocol bridges. Define and implement range-based access control for secured memory and register paths across HBW and LBW. Own privilege qualification and policy propagation across AXI-Lite, APB, IOSF-SB, and HBW request paths. Design and validate parity/ECC generation and checking for request, response, and data channels. Define fault behavior for unauthorized accesses and corrupt transactions, including silent block semantics, RAZWI-style handling, poison propagation, and timeout cleanup. Build or integrate logging, interrupt, and firmware-visible error harvesting flows for local and global RAS handling. Support error injection, diagnostics, and post-silicon debug hooks for both security and reliability validation. Define and implement telemetry capture for fabric load, latency, congestion, error context, and other operational health indicators. Own debug and trace data paths for wrapper-level and fabric-level observability, including data capture, transport, formatting, and handoff to downstream debug infrastructure. Design counters, sticky status, snapshots, and firmware-visible CSRs that make performance and failure analysis practical. Integrate trigger, monitor, and logging hooks needed for bring-up, stress triage, and post-silicon correlation. Work with architecture, validation, firmware, and post-silicon teams to ensure telemetry and debug signals are useful, stable, and diagnosable. Balance observability depth against area, timing, bandwidth, and survivability constraints. Support root-cause analysis of bandwidth loss, latency outliers, protocol stalls, and intermittent field or lab issues using hardware observability features. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop logic designs, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulations required for IP blocks, functional units, and subsystems. Define architecture and microarchitecture features for the IP block being designed. Apply strategies, tools, and methods to optimize RTL design for power, performance, area, and timing targets. Strong knowledge of AXI, AXI-Lite, APB, parity/ECC schemes, and transaction error handling. Experience with secure MMIO, access-control/firewall logic, or privilege-based filtering. Experience with RAS concepts such as fault containment, poison, interrupt generation, logging, and recovery-oriented design. Support So C customers with seamless integration and verification of IP blocks. Telemetry and debug are both observability functions rather than primary Datapath functions. Drive compliance with quality assurance standards to enable smooth IP handoff within the So C development process.
minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. A minimum of 8 years of experience in logic design and RTL development. Proficiency in hardware description languages such as Verilog, System Verilog. Strong understanding of digital design principles, including timing analysis, power optimization, and area trade-offs. Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for design and simulation (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor Graphics). Knowledge of IP block integration workflows within SoC designs. Expertise in RAS/debug/security/telemetry.
preferredQualification: Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 10+ years of professional experience encompassing complex IP logic design for high-performance applications. Demonstrated expertise in architecture and microarchitecture definition. Familiarity with advanced verification methodologies such as UVM or formal verification techniques. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A mindset for continuous learning and improvement, with an eagerness to tackle challenging, innovative design projects. Take the next step in your career and become part of Intel's world-class engineering team, shaping the future of technology with groundbreaking innovations. Apply today to make an impact. Job Type: Experienced Hire Shift: Shift 1 (India)

- Support Sub-system/So C customers with high-quality IP integration and verification workflows.

title: AI Platform and Agentic Engineer
jobDescription:
Intel's Design Quality and Reliability organization is seeking an AI Platform Engineer to architect and build an enterprise-grade AI platform for mission-critical engineering work. This platform will enable Intel engineers to analyze complex design, qualification, and reliability data; automate engineering workflows; access organizational knowledge; and make faster, evidence-based decisions throughout the product lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in AI-native and agentic development. They will be highly proficient with Agentic AI coding assistants and able to use these tools responsibly to accelerate architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. This role requires close collaboration with Design, Quality and Reliability, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, IT, Information Security, and other Intel stakeholders. Responsibilities
1. Architect and develop Intel's reusable AI platform for Design Quality and Reliability.
2. Build AI agents and workflows for engineering data analysis, qualification planning, risk assessment, knowledge retrieval, reporting, and process automation.
3. Apply Agentic AI coding assistants to accelerate software development while maintaining rigorous engineering review and validation.
4. Integrate AI capabilities with Intel engineering databases, quality-management systems, internal APIs, spreadsheets, documentation repositories, and workflow tools.
5. Develop production-grade backend services, APIs, data pipelines, model gateways, and agent-orchestration components.
6. Establish shared platform capabilities for identity, access control, tool authorization, memory, observability, evaluation, and auditability.
7. Implement human approval, deterministic validation, and rollback controls for consequential engineering actions.
8. Design evaluation frameworks using representative Intel Design Quality and Reliability use cases.
9. Establish automated testing, CI/CD, secure configuration, monitoring, documentation, and operational-support practices.
10. Ensure compliance with Intel requirements for intellectual-property protection, data classification, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI.
11. Partner with domain experts to translate engineering workflows into scalable platform capabilities.
12. Mentor engineers in agentic software engineering and the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

Significant experience in software engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or solution architecture. 3. Advanced Python development skills and experience building production APIs and backend services. 4. Demonstrated proficiency with Agentic AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, or comparable agentic software-development platforms. 5. Experience developing LLM applications, AI agents, tool-calling systems, retrieval pipelines, and structured model outputs. 6. Strong knowledge of software architecture, data modeling, design patterns, automated testing, version control, and code review. 7. Experience with CI/CD, logging, monitoring, secrets management, access control, and production operations. 8. Ability to design secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise systems. 9. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications 1. Master's degree in a relevant engineering or computer science discipline. 2. Experience in semiconductor design, silicon validation, product qualification, Design Quality and Reliability, failure analysis, or manufacturing. 3. Familiarity with reliability topics such as device aging, electromigration, ESD, latch-up, TDDB, soft-error reliability, and high-voltage qualification. 4. Experience with statistical analysis, engineering data pipelines, scientific visualization, and large engineering datasets. 5. Experience integrating enterprise databases, document repositories, laboratory systems, and quality-management platforms. 6. Familiarity with containers, cloud or on-premises platforms, relational databases, vector search, caching, and asynchronous processing. 7. Experience with AI evaluation, prompt testing, model observability, governance, and responsible-AI controls. 8. Experience building systems that require traceability, reproducibility, audit readiness, and protection of confidential intellectual property. What Success Looks Like The successful candidate will establish a trusted AI foundation for Intel's Design Quality and Reliability organization-not a collection of isolated prototypes. The platform will securely scale across engineering use cases, deliver explainable and traceable results, preserve appropriate human oversight, and measurably accelerate Intel's mission-critical quality and reliability work. Intel's P-Core organization is seeking a highly experienced engineering manager to lead the Memory Execution Unit (MEU) Front-End development team responsible for delivering world-class CPU microarchitecture solutions for next-generation Server and Client products. This role requires a strong technical leader who can build and grow a high-performing organization, drive execution excellence, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver predictable first time-right silicon. People Leadership • Lead and grow an experienced team of RTL, DV, and Formal Verification engineers and technical leads. • Build leadership bench strength and succession plans. • Drive talent development, mentoring, career growth, retention, and organization health. • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with Architecture, Design, Validation, Physical Design, DFT, Power, Security, and Product Engineering teams. Influence technical decisions across multiple organizations and geographies. Drive effective stakeholder management and executive communication. Quality and Execution Excellence
- Deliver predictable execution against major CPU program milestones, bug prevention, early bug interception, coverage closure, and validation quality improvements. jobDescription:
Job Description: Role Overview As an Integrated Voltage Regulator (IVR) Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and implementation of high-performance power management solutions directly integrated onto advanced processors (CPUs, GPUs, or So Cs). You will work at the intersection of Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design and Power Electronics to improve energy efficiency and performance in next-generation computing systems. Key Responsibilities Circuit Architecture and Design: Develop and refine analog topologies such as Operational Amplifiers (Op-Amps), Bandgap References, Data Converters (ADC/DAC), and Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs). Design and Simulation: Perform transistor-level design using industry-standard tools (like Cadence Virtuoso). Conduct extensive Monte Carlo simulations, corner analysis, and noise analysis to ensure high yield and reliability. Layout Oversight: Collaborate closely with layout engineers to guide critical placement and routing, focusing on matching, shielding, and minimizing parasitic capacitance/resistance. Verification: Use SPICE-based simulators to verify circuit functionality against rigorous performance specifications (speed, power, gain, etc.). Post-Silicon Characterization: Bench-test silicon prototypes in the lab to validate performance against pre-silicon models and debug hardware anomalies

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required Technical Skills Transistor Fundamentals: Expert knowledge of MOSFET/BJT device physics, small-signal modeling, and aging effects. EDA Tool Proficiency: Mastery of Cadence (Spectre/Virtuoso), Mentor Graphics, or Synopsys tool suites. Signal Integrity: Deep understanding of thermal noise, jitter, crosstalk, and power supply rejection ratio (PSRR). Mixed-Signal Flow: Familiarity with Verilog-A or Verilog-AMS for behavioral modeling of analog blocks. Qualifications

EDUCATION:

BS, MS, or Ph D in Electrical Engineering (EE) with a concentration in Analog IC Design. Experience: 3

title: Cloud Software Development Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description: The Role and Impact Seeking a Cloud Automation/Deployment Engineer with 5+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, Dev Ops, and automation. Responsibilities include building CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes-based deployment platforms, infrastructure automation, observability, and release management for cloud and edge solutions. Strong expertise in Kubernetes, Docker, Git Hub Actions/Jenkins, Terraform, Python, Linux, and cloud platforms is required. Experience managing large-scale deployments, platform reliability, monitoring, and automation of cloud-native workloads is highly desirable. Business group This role is part of Intel Corporation, a global leader in technology innovation. You will join a team focused on security and software development within Intel's Client Computing Group (CCG), which drives advancements in computing platforms and solutions. This group plays a critical role in ensuring that Intel's products meet the evolving needs of secure, high-performance cloud environments and supports Intel's broader mission of delivering world-class technology solutions. Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement security features for cloud stacks using modern software development practices.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including vulnerability assessment, compliance, and technical groups, to gather requirements and address cloud security challenges.
- Develop, integrate, and review cloud hosting solutions with a focus on continuous security hardening.
- Work with container technologies such as Kubernetes, Open Shift, and Docker to ensure secure and efficient cloud deployment.
- Implement security across applications, integrations, databases, and processes using technologies like SAML, JWT, OAuth, SSL, and m TLS.
- Manage and secure Linux operating systems, including Cent OS and Ubuntu, for cloud-hosted environments.
- Document risks, security controls, and evidence to meet compliance standards, ensuring alignment with frameworks like CIS and Docker Bench Security.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field with 4+ years of hands-on experience in cloud software development. Alternatively, a Master's degree in a relevant field with 3+ years of experience, or a Ph D in a relevant field with no prior professional experience.
- Proficiency in full-stack development with Core Java, Spring Boot, and Angular (or similar Web UI frameworks).
- Strong knowledge of container technologies, including Kubernetes and Open Shift, and experience with Docker or Linux containers.
- Expertise in cloud hosting and infrastructure security, including application, integration, and database security.
- Ability to implement protocols and technologies such as SAML, JWT, OAuth, SSL, and m TLS.
- Working knowledge of managing and securing Linux operating systems. Preferred Qualifications
- Certifications such as Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
- Familiarity with security frameworks, controls, and processes, including CIS and Docker Bench Security.
- Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in diverse teams. Join us in shaping the future of secure cloud solutions and making a meaningful impact in the technology industry.

title: Silicon Packaging Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description: Join our team as a Silicon Packaging Design Engineer in the Data Center Group, where you will play a pivotal role in crafting cutting-edge silicon packaging solutions that drive Intel's innovation and technological leadership. In this role, you will be engaged in the end-to-end development of substrate designs, from concept to tapeout, ensuring optimized performance and manufacturability. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, your contributions will directly impact product quality, cost efficiency, and time-to-market for Intel's next-generation technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to start your career in a collaborative environment that fosters learning and professional growth. Key Responsibilities
- Drive the complete development of substrate designs, starting from initial concept through tapeout.
- Perform physical layout and routing of package designs, ensuring adherence to design requirements.
- Conduct substrate fit and routing studies to establish optimal tradeoffs between design, performance, and cost.
- Collaborate with silicon and hardware teams to optimize silicon-package-board performance and pinout configurations.
- Define and implement substrate design rules to meet product and manufacturing requirements.
- Perform internal and external design reviews, analyze data, and resolve design rule violations (DRCs).
- Integrate design documentation and collateral into the product lifecycle management system.
- Continuously seek opportunities to improve package design for manufacturability (DFM) and quality assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications
- Diploma in Electronic/ Electrical Engineering or a related field.
- six months or more years of work experience in Semiconductor field related to design of silicon packaging or PCB.
- Novice to intermediate proficiency in substrate design and development, including physical layout and routing.
- Basic understanding of I/O fundamentals, package interconnect, and power delivery principles.
- Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM) and quality assurance processes.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a disciplined approach to execution. Preferred Qualifications -Preferred experience into E-CAD tool.
- Effective communication skills to convey technical information and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
- A proactive mindset to identify design improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with project goals.
- Passion for driving innovation and contributing to complex engineering challenges. This is your opportunity to be part of Intel's legacy of innovation while developing your skills and advancing your career.
